The Economics Institute for Judges offered by the Law & Economics Center was presented from March 14 through
March 21, 2025. The program was held at the Henderson Resort in Destin, Florida.
The Economics Institute for Judges consisted of 22 hours and 30 minutes of instruction, excluding breaks.
There was no tuition and the Law & Economics Center budgeted $1,883.00 for lodging and $940.00 for group meals,
excluding taxes and fees, for each participant. Attendees were eligible for qualifying travel reimbursement. The travel
reimbursement was $431.16.

Educational program provided by George Mason University, Law and Economics Center.
The Nineteenth Annual Judicial Symposium on Civil Justice Issues offered by the Law & Economics Center from
September 28 to September 30, 2025. The program was held at the Westin Arlington and George Mason University
Antonin Scalia Law School in Arlington, Virginia.
The Nineteenth Annual Judicial Symposium on Civil Justice Issues consisted of 10 hours and 20 minutes of instruction,
excluding breaks.
There was no tuition and the Law & Economics Center budgeted $538.00 for lodging and $331.00 for group meals,
excluding taxes and fees, for each participant. Attendees were eligible for qualifying travel reimbursement. The travel
reimbursement was $334.04.
